```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
data <- read_delim(
  "apartments_for_rent_classified_100K.csv",
  delim = ";",
  quote = "",
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
```

```{r}
sorted_data <- data |>
  ## If the price is listed as weekly, it is multiplied to get a monthly price
  mutate( 
    price = as.numeric(na_if(trimws(price), "null")),
    price = ifelse(
      price_type == "Weekly",
      price * 52 / 12,
      price
    ),
    ## Removes rows with NA values
    bedrooms = as.numeric(na_if(trimws(bedrooms), "null")),
    bathrooms = as.numeric(na_if(trimws(bathrooms), "null")),
    square_feet = as.numeric(na_if(trimws(square_feet), "null")),
    latitude = as.numeric(na_if(trimws(latitude), "null")),
    longitude = as.numeric(na_if(trimws(longitude), "null"))
  ) |>
  ## Limits columns to only required variables
  select(id, price, bedrooms, bathrooms,
         square_feet, cityname, state,
         latitude, longitude) |>
  rename(city = cityname) |>
  ## Converts NULL to NA
  mutate(
    city = na_if(trimws(city), "null"),
    state = na_if(toupper(trimws(state)), "NULL")
  ) |>
  ## Removes NA values from price, bedrooms, bathrooms, city, and state
  filter(
    !is.na(price),
    !is.na(bedrooms),
    !is.na(bathrooms),
    price > 0,
    bedrooms >= 0,
    bathrooms > 0,
    !is.na(city),
    trimws(city) != "",
    !is.na(state),
    trimws(state) != ""
  ) |>
  ## Removes duplicate IDs
  dplyr::distinct(id, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r}
## Writes Sorted Data to New File
write.csv(sorted_data, "apartment_data_updated.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
